_comment: Single source of truth for the machinery. Hooks and CI read this file; nothing hardcodes a command. Keep the Commands section of CLAUDE.md in sync BY POINTING AT THIS FILE, not by copying it.
_eval_comment: Set once evals/ has a runner, e.g. ["python3", "evals/run.py"]. When set, stop_verify and Gate 2 check 3 run it too, and a regression blocks the merge.

diff_cap._comment: Gate 2 check 1 is now mechanical. Over cap = split the slice.

protected._frozen_comment: New files may be created here (test-writer at step 4). Existing files may NOT be edited or overwritten - that is the builder bending the test to fit the code.
protected._always_comment: The governor may not edit itself. .github/ is here because CI is the only check that runs outside the agent's reach - an agent that can rewrite the workflow can delete its own gate. It also becomes an exfiltration path the moment a repo secret exists (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for evals): the workflow runs on GitHub's runner, where danger_block cannot see it.
protected._unlock_comment: To amend a frozen test: human runs `touch .claude/.unlock` (or writes a path prefix into it), agent makes the change, hook consumes and deletes the unlock. Every unlock is logged to .claude/.events.log and must be named in the slice log.

notify._channels_comment: Set whichever env vars you use. NTFY_TOPIC is the zero-setup mobile option: pick a hard-to-guess topic, install the ntfy app, subscribe. NOTIFY_WEBHOOK takes a generic JSON POST (Slack, Discord, Telegram bot relay).
notify._levels_comment: Everything else lands in .claude/.events.log only, for the morning digest.
